translation.Hips: pelvis (local to root; root rests at the origin with an identity rotation, so the value is unchanged)

ue5_apose.note: UE5 Mannequin-like A-pose as local rotations on this skeleton (bind stays I-pose): arms 45 deg below horizontal, elbows 15, palms down and in (upper arm 40 in, hand 50 in, twist bones their shares), legs 4 apart

frames: Bones run along local +Y; Z points to the side the child swings into on flexion; X = Y x Z. Flexion is +X for spine, neck, head, elbows, knees, fingers, thumb, wrist (palm-ward), ankle (toes up), ball (toes up), jaw (open); eyes: +X looks up. Mirrored sides: X same world direction, Y and Z reflected.
